license_note: The official Mistral AI model card identifies Apache-2.0 as the license for the published Pixtral 12B repository and checkpoint. The repository exposes the license identifier in its pinned model card rather than a separate license file.

license_evidence.scope: Official Pixtral-12B-2409 model repository, consolidated Safetensors checkpoint, tokenizer, and parameters

access_boundary: This record represents the Pixtral-12B-2409 instruction release. The base model, hosted Mistral services, downstream quantizations and fine-tunes, and later Pixtral releases remain separate boundaries.
strengths: Mistral AI publishes a directly downloadable consolidated checkpoint and tokenizer artifacts
The official model card documents a self-operated vLLM path and names the distribution license
tradeoffs: The license statement is carried in model-card metadata instead of a repository license file
The model card recommends a particular serving stack, so portability beyond documented paths needs independent runtime review

evidence.label: Official model card, checkpoint, and vLLM deployment guidance
